title_zh: 确认自行车修理内容和取车时间

scenario.goal_zh: 检查车况、讨论维修必要性并确认取车时间。

context_zh: 骑车人把刹车失灵且轮圈不正的车推到维修店，与店员核对处理安排。
author: author-phase05-a

sentences.speaker: Tomas
sentences.text: I brought the bike on foot because the front brake barely works.

sentences.speaker: Bike mechanic
sentences.text: Let me look. The cable is damaged, and the front wheel is not running straight.

sentences.speaker: Tomas
sentences.text: Can you fix both, or do I need a new bike?

sentences.speaker: Bike mechanic
sentences.text: The frame is fine. I can replace the brake cable and straighten the wheel.

sentences.speaker: Tomas
sentences.text: How much will that be, and when could I collect it?

sentences.speaker: Bike mechanic
sentences.text: Thirty-five pounds for the work and parts. It will be ready tomorrow after three.

sentences.speaker: Tomas
sentences.text: Please go ahead. I will come at four tomorrow.

sentences.speaker: Bike mechanic
sentences.text: I will put that on the job card and call you if anything changes.
